rationale: ScriptedUiSession::load_now() now runs one WidgetBridge::service_param_bindings() pass after a successful mount, so a deferred (view-first or content-first) scripted document's mount frame shows bindWidgetToParam controls at their parameter values instead of their construction defaults; the frame pump already ran the same service one poll later. Adds a Catch2 regression in test/test_scripted_ui.cpp. Generic scripted-UI runtime behavior that Vellum's JS UI runtime unit inherits (vellum-move ledger F-firstframe); no design-import, Chromium, rendering, or packaging authority moves.
